description: The plot illustrates the average repetition rate of words between generated training samples across different relation categories. The x-axis, labeled "Relation Category", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 60, and is marked at intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled "Average Repetition Rate", also has a linear scale, ranges from 0.0 to 0.6, and is marked at intervals of 0.1. Three solid lines are shown: the blue line, representing "w/o DPO obo", starts around 0.1, peaks at approximately 0.62 at relation category 2, and ends around 0.25 at relation category 60; the orange line, representing "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint", begins around 0.3, fluctuates throughout, and ends around 0.15; the green line, representing "DPO", starts at about 0.23, generally stays below 0.2, and ends around 0.17. Additionally, three dashed lines represent the averages of the respective solid lines: blue dashed line at 0.163 for "w/o DPO obo", orange dashed line at 0.227 for "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint", and green dashed line at 0.117 for "DPO".
